book.name: 1 Abhatesaronike
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhatesaronike

content: Obhwiikari bhuno Taatabhugya abhuseegiri

Bhoono abhahiiri bheetu, mweegiri okurwa kweetwe kyeego mukweenderwa kwiikara, okubha mumuzomeerye Taatabhugya. Ni heene niigo mukwiikara. Bhoono, turabhiisasaama kubhuturo bhwo Omukuru Yeesu, mubhe murageenderera okukora ego na kukiraho.
Mumenyiri bhuzomu obhuswaagyo bhuno tukabhaswaagya kwo obhuturo bhwo Omukuru Yeesu.
Taatabhugya areenda mubhe ni bhaatu abhahoreeru, mwiiriihe okukora obhuseebheeti.
Emwe mwoosi mubhaahe emibhiri gyeenyu, mubhuhoreeru no okwiisuuka.
Mutabha ne enaamba embiihu kyeego abhaatu bhano bhatamumenyiri Taatabhugya.
Kugayo, Omukrisito wowoosi atamusariirya omurikyaaye, naabhe kumukaangirirya. Tumariri kubhabhuurira no okubharekya kubha, bhoosi bhano bhakukora gayo, Omukuru Yeesu niwe araabhatinire ekiina.
Taatabhugya ataatubhirikiiri kukora amakire gogoosi, nawe akatubhirikira kubha twiikare mubhuhoreeru.
Kweego omuutu wowoosi wuno araange ameegyo gano, atakumwaanga muutu, nawe aramwaanga Taatabhugya, wuno akubhaha emwe Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Bhoono, etakweenderwa tubhakaamire emwe iguru yo okuseegana, kwo okubha emwe abheene mweegiibhwe na Taatabhugya okuseegana.
Eheene murabhakorera ego abharikyeenyu bhoosi bhano muri mukyaaro kyoosi kya Makedonia. Bhoono turabhasabha, abhahiiri bheetu, mugeenderere kukora ego no okukira.
Mubhe ne ekoro yo okwiikara obhwiikari bhwo omureembe. Omuutu wowoosi atiisikirya mumangʼana ga abhaandi, nawe akore emirimo gyaaye omweene, kyeego tukabhaswaagya.
Hayo murabha mweerekirye eteemwa enzomu kubhaatu bhano bhatari Abhakrisito. Kweeki mutakubha abhaatu bhano bhakwiiteengera bhya abhaandi.
Abhakrisito bhano bhaakuuri bhararyooka okurwa mubhaku
Emwe abhahiiri bheetu, tureenda mumenye gano garaatuuke ku Bhakrisito bhano bhakuuri, okubha mutabha ne ebhigoongi kyeego abhaatu abhaandi bhano bhatana obhwiisige bhwo okuryooka.
Etwe tumenyiri kubha, Yeesu akakwa no okuryooka no okubha muhoru kweeki. Kweego, turiisigira kubha Taatabhugya araabharyoore no okubhareeta hamwe na Yeesu abhiikirirya bhoosi bhano bhaakuuri.
Ambe, gano tukubhabhuurira ni meegyo go Omukuru Yeesu, kubha etwe bhano tukubha abhahoru hano ewe araakyoore, tutakubhakaangatira bhano bhaakuuri kurorana neewe.

Omukuru omweene ariituuma okurwa mwiisaaro. Arabhuga kwe eriiraka rya amanaga, hamwe ne eriiraka rya maraika omukuru ne eriiraka rye ekoombyo ya Taatabhugya. Niho bhano bhaakuuri bhamwiikiriirye Krisito, bhararyoorwa obhutaangiro.
Okumara etwe bhano turaabhe bhahoru, turasaakurwa hamwe nabho mumasaaro, okubha tumusuungʼaane Omukuru kwiisaaro. Niho turiikara hamwe neewe kirakeego.
Bhoono mugosoreranie kumangʼana gayo.
